title: The canonical reference backend: a recipe that fixes the arithmetic, a runtime that is the declared one
note: tools/reference_backend.py and reference_backend/ (D-2026-102): the recipe check refuses anything that leaves the arithmetic to the host (DYNAMIC_ARCH, a host TARGET, threads, NumPy runtime dispatch or a native baseline, forbidden flags in the spec or the scripts' code, FMA contraction, a passthrough CPU, an unstated FP policy, unpinned sources, scripts that do not apply the spec); the conformance check, run inside the reference runtime, refuses a backend that is not the declared one, failing closed on anything unrecorded; the reference identity keeps what the dispatchers saw and leaves out the host's cpuinfo. RBS1-RBS15 mutate the recipe itself -- spec.json, build.sh, run.sh -- as directive 7 s.37 lists: each must be refused by the recipe check the CI runs.

mutations.name: RB1_dynamic_arch_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: the host picks the OpenBLAS kernel at load time and the recipe still passes

mutations.name: RB2_a_host_target_is_one_target
mutations.find: if not ob.get("TARGET") or ob["TARGET"].upper() in ("HOST", "NATIVE"):
mutations.rationale: TARGET=HOST builds for whatever machine compiles it

mutations.name: RB3_threading_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
if ob.get("USE_THREAD") != "0" or ob.get("NUM_THREADS") != "1" or \
            ob.get("USE_OPENMP") != "0":
mutations.rationale: a threaded OpenBLAS reorders reductions by thread count

mutations.name: RB4_numpy_dispatch_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: NumPy keeps AVX2/AVX-512 implementations for the runtime dispatcher to prefer

mutations.name: RB5_a_native_baseline_is_fixed
mutations.rationale: cpu-baseline=native compiles the build host's ISA into every function

mutations.name: RB6_forbidden_flags_only_in_the_spec
mutations.find: if f in flags or f in build or f in run:
mutations.rationale: a -march=native in build.sh itself passes the recipe check

mutations.name: RB7_comments_are_code
mutations.find:
return "\n".join(line for line in text.splitlines()
                     if not line.lstrip().startswith("#"))
mutations.rationale: a script that says it never uses -march=native is refused for saying so

mutations.name: RB8_fma_contraction_is_not_checked

mutations.name: RB9_thread_variables_are_not_checked

mutations.name: RB10_a_passthrough_cpu_is_a_software_cpu

mutations.name: RB11_no_emulator_is_needed

mutations.name: RB12_an_unresolved_fp_policy_is_stated
mutations.find: if not v or "UNRESOLVED" in v.upper():
mutations.rationale: an empty or UNRESOLVED floating-point policy passes as stated

mutations.name: RB13_sources_need_not_be_pinned
mutations.rationale: a source fetched by name alone, any bytes accepted

mutations.name: RB14_build_script_need_not_apply_the_spec

mutations.name: RB15_run_script_need_not_apply_the_spec

mutations.name: RB16_host_cpu_passthrough_in_run_is_accepted
mutations.rationale: run.sh passes -cpu max after the declared CPU and the last one wins

mutations.name: RB17_an_unresolved_backend_conforms
mutations.find: if not isinstance(rt, dict) or record.get("backend_status") != "RESOLVED":
mutations.rationale: a backend the probe could not name is certified as the reference

mutations.find: if not targets or not all(t.startswith("baseline") for t in targets):
mutations.rationale: NumPy ran AVX2 kernels and the runtime conforms

mutations.name: RB19_compiled_dispatch_is_ignored

mutations.name: RB20_baseline_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: a NumPy built for X86_V3 conforms

mutations.name: RB21_cpu_features_are_not_checked
mutations.rationale: the CPU offers AVX2/FMA: not the declared software CPU, and it conforms

        out.append("no OpenBLAS was identified")
mutations.rationale: a runtime with no identified BLAS conforms vacuously

mutations.name: RB23_kernel_is_not_compared

mutations.name: RB25_blas_parallel_is_not_compared

mutations.name: RB28_interpreter_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: another build of Python 3.12 conforms

mutations.name: RB29_no_build_record_skips_the_libraries

mutations.name: RB31_flushed_subnormals_conform

mutations.rationale: a non-default rounding mode conforms

mutations.name: RB33_identity_includes_host_cpuinfo
mutations.rationale: two hosts on the same software CPU never share an identity: qemu-user shows each the host's cpuinfo

mutations.name: RB35_identity_drops_system_libraries

mutations.name: RB36_identity_drops_the_spec

mutations.name: RB37_identity_drops_the_native_build

mutations.name: RB38_libm_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: the host's libm, whose IFUNCs pick FMA variants, passes as the rootfs's

mutations.name: RB39_the_loader_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: a different dynamic loader resolves the IFUNCs and passes

mutations.name: RB40_identity_drops_the_virtual_cpu
mutations.rationale: a different declared software CPU yields the same identity

mutations.name: RB41_verify_certifies_whatever_runs
mutations.rationale: the runtime identity is accepted however it differs from the declaration

mutations.name: RB42_identity_named_despite_nonconformance
mutations.find: identity = reference_identity(spec, record) if not problems else None
mutations.rationale: a non-conformant runtime still publishes a reference identity digest

mutations.name: RB43_verify_ignores_the_build_record
mutations.rationale: the rootfs's library digests are never compared

mutations.name: RB44_a_patch_is_not_compared_to_its_pin

mutations.name: RB45_a_patch_need_not_be_explained

                not _HEX64.match(pt.get("sha256") or ""):
mutations.rationale: a patch with no stated reason or target changes the reference source

mutations.name: RB46_patch_verification_in_build_is_not_checked
mutations.rationale: build.sh applies patches it never verified

mutations.name: RBT1_one_cpu_class_is_two_hosts
mutations.rationale: the same machine twice is reported as host independence

mutations.name: RBT2_reference_identities_are_not_compared
mutations.rationale: two hosts whose reference runtimes differ are compared byte for byte as if they were one

mutations.name: RBT3_a_missing_output_is_agreement
mutations.find:
if a["outputs"].get(n) is None or
              a["outputs"].get(n) != b["outputs"].get(n)]
mutations.rationale: a file neither host produced counts as identical

mutations.name: RBT4_exempt_files_are_compared
mutations.rationale: the exempt file's run-to-run bytes fail a proof they are not part of

mutations.name: RBT5_conformance_is_not_required
mutations.rationale: a host whose runtime was not the declared one takes part in the proof

mutations.name: RBT6_emulators_are_not_compared
mutations.find:
if not a.get("emulator_sha256") or \
            a.get("emulator_sha256") != b.get("emulator_sha256"):
mutations.rationale: two different emulator builds are the same software CPU

mutations.name: RBT7_recipes_are_not_compared
mutations.rationale: two hosts running different recipes are compared

mutations.name: RBT8_the_marketing_name_is_the_class
mutations.rationale: one CPU sold under two names is two hosts

mutations.name: RBT9_the_feature_set_is_not_the_class
mutations.rationale: a host with and without AVX-512 is one CPU class

mutations.name: RBT10_no_scope_is_a_proof

mutations.name: RBT11_the_command_passes_whatever_the_verdict

                not rec["physical_host"].get("flags_sha256"):

mutations.name: RBT13_generators_are_not_compared
mutations.find:

            a.get("generator_digest") != b.get("generator_digest"):
